title: Social Worker Caseload at Family Service Centres
what_it_is: Social Worker Caseload at Family Service Centres

sections.label: Social worker caseload ratio
sections.summary: The Minister was asked about average and median social worker to caseload ratios at family service centres for FY2021/2022, and said he had no specific answers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development for FY2021/2022, what is the average and median social worker to caseload ratio at family service centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: One, it seems like the caseload has dropped, so could I ask what efforts the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) has put in, in terms of reducing the amount of work for our social workers?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: And two, whether there is also a similar reduction in the amount of administrative work that social workers are doing in the last FY?

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: I do not have specific answers to those points raised.

sections.label: Family service centre work quality
sections.summary: The speaker says some family service centres perform better than others, wants to uplift their work quality, and notes social workers' load is one factor being looked at.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: It is that kind of place where you want to come to work and really feel sad that it is a Friday and you are going for your weekend.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are not there yet, but I can say that some of the FSCs are doing far better than others and we really want to uplift their quality of work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Certainly, the load with which our social workers are facing is one of the many factors that we are looking at.
